About Us
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here .

Target Tech creates and operates the tools, technology, science, and systems that enable every part of Target’s business and creates compelling and joyful experiences for our team members and guests. Our success is rooted in our diverse and talented team employing architectural discipline, agile execution, innovation, and operational excellence. While we create new capabilities to drive engagement, efficiency, and growth, we also prioritize investing in our technology ecosystem to keep it reliable, performant, and secure. We believe empowering our team to solve problems, fostering continuous learning and innovation, and building strong team connections enables us to deliver more, faster, and with higher quality. And with more joy.

As a Lead Strategist, you will:
Help shape and accelerate the work that matters most across Target’s Technology organization during a pivotal chapter for the enterprise. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, execution, and organizational effectiveness, you will partner with senior Technology leaders to frame complex problems, shape strategy and priorities, and translate strategic direction into measurable action.

You will lead critical bodies of work spanning strategy and planning, portfolio leadership, and priority acceleration. You will bring clarity to ambiguity, connect insights across Technology, facilitate critical decisions, and create the structure and alignment needed to move work forward. You will help Technology anticipate what's next while continuously strengthening how we plan, prioritize, make decisions, and execute.

Strategic Thinking and Strategy Development
- Structure ambiguous strategic questions, define the approach required to solve them, and develop strategies and recommendations through research, analysis, synthesis, and evaluation of options and tradeoffs.
- Partner across Technology and the enterprise to develop and evolve multi-year Technology priorities, connecting enterprise strategy, emerging opportunities, and Technology capabilities to inform future direction.
- Translate strategic direction into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and actionable plans.

Strategic Execution and Program Leadership
- Lead complex strategic initiatives from framing through execution, establishing clear outcomes, plans, governance, decision architecture, and accountability.
- Create visibility across priorities by connecting progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to drive decisions and maintain momentum.
- Build alignment and commitment across Technology and enterprise partners, translating complex topics into clear narratives and facilitating decisions that move work forward.

Change Management
- Anticipate organizational implications of strategic initiatives and help leaders and teams navigate significant change.
- Develop stakeholder, communication, and adoption approaches that enable new strategies, capabilities, and ways of working to take hold.
- Apply insights and learnings to strengthen Technology's planning, governance, decision-making, and operating model.

Strategic Perspective and Foresight
- Connect signals and insights across Technology, the enterprise, and external environment to identify emerging themes, opportunities, and risks.
- Translate emerging trends into future scenarios and implications for Technology's priorities and operating model.
- Anticipate downstream implications of strategic choices to help leaders make informed decisions today while preparing Technology for what's next.

We’ll support you along the way with onboarding, as well as personal and career development, to help you grow as a strong Lead Strategist. The exciting part of retail? It’s always changing!

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

About You
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 5+ years of relevant experience in strategy, consulting, program leadership, technology, operations, or related fields.
- Proven experience developing strategy and shaping strategic direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Strategic thinker and structured problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, synthesize complex information, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop clear recommendations.
- Strong strategic operator who can translate direction into action, mobilize cross-functional teams, and drive complex work forward with clarity and accountability.
- Exceptional communicator, storyteller, and facilitator who can develop compelling narratives, structure productive leader discussions, influence decisions, and build alignment across diverse stakeholders.
- Comfortable operating with pace, ambiguity, and changing priorities , with the ability to move fluidly between big-picture strategic thinking and execution detail.
- Brings enterprise perspective, intellectual curiosity, and sound judgment , with the ability to anticipate downstream implications and stay current on Technology, AI, business trends, and emerging opportunities.
- Demonstrates high accountability, adaptability, and bias toward action.

Working within Merchandising Capabilities , your mission will be to help build and sustain an industry-leading portfolio of global capabilities that drive financial growth, enable efficiency, and unlock joy for each Guest. Our teams and products are aligned to key enterprise functions to accelerate and support Target’s strategy through connected processes, innovative technology, and a best-in-class team. Your work will span building the process and capability for long-range planning that syncs with in-season execution, ensuring that Clearance is positioned as a strategic lever across the organization. Your influence will extend into critical clearance price initiatives (like flex fulfill clearance) that impact our guest and teams across the enterprise.

In addition, you’ll be a key player in enterprise level EOS planning efforts—supporting cross-functional teams during high-impact seasonal transitions (like Q4) and ensuring that strategic intent translates to effective execution. Your success will rely on your ability to lead through influence, drive cross-functional alignment, and use data to identify risks and opportunities. You'll bring strategic problem-solving, strong communication, and a collaborative mindset to a highly dynamic space. In turn, we’ll support you with robust onboarding, development resources, and the chance to grow as a strategic thought partner across the enterprise. The exciting part of retail? It’s always changing—and Clearance is no exception.
